description: For any surface with TRAIN_RETRY>=N_min AND natural KEEP usage exists in corpus/production, require TRAIN_KEEP>=K_min for that surface
For high-frequency KEEP surfaces that appear inside a labeled malformed region under V2 region semantics, allow RETRY supervision on that region projection
No generation/filter rule may branch on literal token equality for 四/温/背/烧/上/对/苏 or any fixed char list
No rule may branch on dialog_200 caseId (d002/d179/...)
KEEP examples: surface may equal RETRY-heavy surfaces when local region is clean / non-malformed; prefer alternate paths and clean utterances
RETRY examples: common KEEP surfaces inside independently labeled malformed regions get RETRY by region projection not by token
Per surface with support>=S: ratio=RETRY/(KEEP+RETRY); classify LEAKAGE_RISK_HIGH/MODERATE/LOW
Do not create RETRY for 顺/便 from historical 向木李; current 顺便看看项目里 is STALE_TARGET_NOT_COMPARABLE
